After record dialog repair, actual note dialog overflowed bottom by 32 pixels in the same viewport.

fix: AlertDialog.scrollable=true with title/content sharing the scrollable area; removed nested content-only scroll container. Actions and all save/exit/failure logic preserved.
flows: Create via actual input and save
Quick increment and targeted undo with unrelated facts and notes preserved
BackupFiles.open selected payload through actual DataScreen preview/cancel/back/confirm
Repository reload and protected original-snapshot reload after recovery
boundaries: Host widget tests with production MemoryHabitRepository and a fake BackupFiles.open selection, not a claim of physical Android SQLite/SAF execution.
High DPR tests change the effective logical viewport; actual system display-settings experience, TalkBack, physical rotation lifecycle and back gesture remain separate.
This targeted result is not the final whole-repository regression or official release.
